user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents securely, extract text using OCR, identify PII, and store the metadata in a graph database for relationship querying.
normalized_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform that enables secure PDF upload, OCR-based text extraction, PII detection, and graph-based metadata storage with relationship querying capabilities.
domain: Document Intelligence / Data Extraction & Privacy Compliance

requirements.description: Users must securely upload PDF documents with access control and encryption
System must extract text from PDF documents using OCR
System must detect and identify personally identifiable information (PII) within extracted text
System must store document metadata and PII findings in a queryable graph structure
Users must be able to query relationships between entities (documents, PII, metadata) via graph queries
System must enforce authentication and authorization for user access
System must provide audit logging and monitoring of document processing and access

components.name: SECURE_DOCUMENT_UPLOAD
components.description: Handles secure PDF file ingestion with encryption in transit and at rest, file validation, and virus scanning

components.name: OCR_TEXT_EXTRACTION
components.description: Processes PDF documents to extract text using optical character recognition and document preprocessing

components.name: PII_DETECTION_ENGINE
components.description: Identifies and classifies personally identifiable information (names, SSNs, emails, phone numbers, etc.) in extracted text using AI models

components.name: GRAPH_DATABASE_STORAGE
components.description: Stores document metadata, extracted entities, PII findings, and their relationships in a graph database for relationship-based queries

components.name: GRAPH_QUERY_ENGINE
components.description: Enables querying relationships between documents, entities, PII, and metadata via graph traversal and pattern matching

components.name: API_AND_ORCHESTRATION
components.description: Provides REST/GraphQL APIs for document upload, processing status, query submission, and result retrieval; orchestrates workflow between components

components.name: USER_INTERFACE
components.description: Web-based dashboard for document upload, viewing extracted content, PII findings, and executing graph queries

components.name: AUTHENTICATION_AND_AUTHORIZATION
components.description: Manages user authentication, role-based access control, and document-level permissions

components.name: AUDIT_LOGGING_AND_MONITORING
components.description: Logs all document access, processing events, and system operations; provides monitoring dashboards and alerts for suspicious activity

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into functional components: secure PDF upload, OCR text extraction, PII identification, and graph database metadata storage with relationship querying.
Identify public/open-source solutions, libraries, and AWS services for PDF handling, OCR engines, PII detection models, and graph database technologies that could support this platform.
Assess the discovered candidates against requirements: AWS integration, security, accuracy for OCR and PII detection, graph database capabilities, and production-readiness.
Determine for each component whether to REUSE existing solutions, ADAPT open-source projects, or BUILD custom code based on evaluation results.
Create a detailed technical blueprint including architecture diagrams, component integration points, AWS service configuration, deployment workflow, and implementation priorities.
Validate the blueprint against security requirements, AWS best practices, scalability needs, and feasibility of executing the plan with available resources.
